body:
Founder, with a screenshot: 'work on alignment and increase contrast' / 'review the photo its a little jacked up.' Root causes found in the real CSS: .project-header had no flex-wrap across 12+ toolbar controls (browser squeezed them instead of wrapping -- the real cause of cut-off button labels); .dims had zero layout properties at all (labels/inputs fell back to broken inline flow); --color-muted was only 60% opacity (too faint at small sizes, read as a stray line under material names in the materials list). Fixed all three, plus real daisyUI checkbox styling and a restructured materials-list row layout. Commit 27e31d7.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix SHANKPIT level editor alignment + contrast
